verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can "choose from leading LLMs optimized for speed, accuracy, or cost." The supported-models reference says Copilot supports multiple AI models with different strengths, and an auto-select option picks the best model per task. Multiple providers are implied by the option to assign work to agents from Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI (Codex). Missing for 10: an explicit list of model providers in the picker, documentation of how model selection works per session or per surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
